content: Wawas Agiris asi Baibebe
Pharisee yangan a Baifafaro an baibebeotis fani on Jerusalem emon sinat ato siruayo Iesu sikufifinai.
Osi sisagob Iesu an baigibubunuotis fani on men imas sisosouen weie bayu si’yam on- Pharisee yangan sau on sabu on imas men an etai bag sesosouen weie bayu sam on.
(Osi Pharisee yangan tous a Jew yangan fani mat on wawas a agiris asi baibebe sibites on sebigibubunuai: osi on imas an etai bag sesosouen tiwag weie bayu sam;

on eb baitotobon an efan emon bayu sebobo senat on ainau sesosouen weie gibui sam. Osi on baifafaro sigaraba sibites on nanaba sebigibubunuen, ato an etai bag nan viga, naukwat, ramo a babar on engon sesosouen.)

On mes Pharisee yangan a Baifafaro an baibebeotis on Iesu sitetemai siyau, “Om aibo mes am baigibubunuotis on men atonio wawat agirit asi baibebe sibitet on sebigibubunuai on, baise osi on imas duma aumas bayu sam?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Isaiah on dura bag omi aurim on ikakafun! ‘Omi on baisigogo’otim, on nanaba igayam:

content.text: God iyau, ‘Atonio osi sabuis on duraiai wat on Yau sekakafeu baise osi nunuas Yau auriu on totor nanenei bag sen.
Osi on men dura bag Yau sekwakwafireu on, yabin osi on orot jever baifafaro sifofour on sebibebeyes, on sitau osi on God an baifafaro bait!’

content: “Omi on God an baifafaro dura wobisisiwei ato orot jever asi baibebe on auris wobifonabo.”
Ato Iesu dura ibotein iyau, “Omi on eta wosagob tiwag maiau God an baifafaro dura on wobisisiweiai ato omi toum ami baibebe on woboai.
Yabin Moses an baifafaro iyau, ‘Ayom tamam wonkakafes,’ ato ‘Iyai iyafan dura komasis ayon, taman auris inbikakafun on sinirabobai.’
Baise omi on orot o jever wobibebeyis on aifan sawar eboai on ayon taman inibaisis mes, ab on yau, ‘Nin in men omi anibaisim, Nin on Corban’ (an yabin min on God noan.)
On bobo nanaba wobibebeyes ato ayos tamas on arimon men sinibaisis on.
Atonio etaiai on omi ato baibebe sabu fani wobites ato God an dura on sebikirir efefeu. Ato omi min bobo fani atonio nanaba komasis on sigaraba maiau wofofour.”
Sawar ato Ebiyamai Orot Jever Edudum
Namon Iesu sabu kuayo iyores men sinat aurin ato iyawures iyau, “Omi sabu engon wontatamiu ato wonsagob tiwag.
Men sawar aifan tani orot jever koun emon inar usin amonai iniyamai inadum on, ab sawar aifan orot jever nunuan amon emon egat on ebiyamai edudum.”
Iesu sabu kuayo ikirires ato irui goa amonai, On an baigibubunuotis on sitetemai atonio dura ibikakafun on itau bubunag sittatam mes.
Iesu osi auris iyau, “Omi sabu on men tani sagobotin ato sabu fani ba. Omi on men wosagob i? Men sawar aifan tani orot jever usin koun emon inar iniyamai inadum on,
an yabin on sawar on men nunuan amonai erur, baise sawar on erur yan amonai ato enan usin turinai emamaseir egat.” (Atonio dura Iesu ikurereb on ibasit ato bayu engon on fofonin tanama.)
Atonio dura on nana ibikakafun i’yau, “Sawar aifan orot nunuan emon egat on ebiyamai edudum.
Ato orot yan emon, nunuan emon on bainonot komasis segat on ebinetewarai bobo komasis efofour, ebabainau, sabu ebirabobis,
ebireg nan, ebiafeyan, bobo komasis ta ta efofour; baisigogo dura ebiyamen, bobo komasis, ebiboboar, ebisigogo, etaseseir, kokok ba-osi komasis engon on orot nunuan emon ebiyamai edudum.”
Jever an Baitutum
Namon Iesu on efan ikirir inai tafanam nan Tyre mafam gagamin bisinai nan. On goa amonai irui ato men igogoi iyafan tani itsagob on nan goa amonai, baise On men fofonin arimon itob itama on.
Jever tani natun jeverei on ayu komasin tefanai imama on Iesu duran itatam on ra kaita inat aurin ato annai nan ifeu sindan irou.
On jever toumanin on Phoenicia emon inat Syria tafanam amonai on nan irat. On jever on Iesu ifefeyanai natun jeverei tefanai dau imama on itfaitan itgat mes.
Baise Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Ainau on ot fifirig gugudis tanitues: Men ibasit fifirig gugudis asi bayu on tanboai tanrebenen kuke auris.”
Jever iyafotai iyau, “Bada, kuke kema babanai semama on eb bayu moso sefefeu on sam!”
On mes Iesu on jever aurin iyau, “Om am baiyafot obin aurin on, unmatabir men am goa aurin, nan arimon natum jeverei ungaturai dau ikirir igat!”
Jever imatabir inai au go ato natun jeverei it nan ireai i’yen; ato dura bag dau on jeverei ikirir igat.
Iesu Kokok Orot Iyawasai
Namon Iesu on tafanam Tyre ikirir ato inai Sidon tafanam amonai mafam engon auyotoat nanaba on asi etaiai ibib inai Galilee kamitai nan.
Sabu fani orot tainan fotin awan kokin on sibo sinat, ato osi Iesu sifefeyanai iman on orot tefanai ityagai mes.
On mes Iesu ekesin mom orot ibo sabu kuayo sikirires ato sinat mabisi nan ato On iman on orot tainan doguai iwan, ikatutur ato orot fafen ibotobon.
Namon Iesu itage au safam ato aumiet iyaratein ato orot iyawur iyau, “Ephphatha” an yabin min, “Eruseren!”
Ra kaita orot tainan itambou ato fafen ibit i’yen on awan iruseren ato ibosuruf dura ikakafun tiwag.
Namon Iesu dura wawaninai sabu iyawures iyau, “Omi men iyafan tani wonkasonai mes.” Ab On osi auris aumiet isosoan dura men sabu sitkasones baise osi on aumiet bag sikakason.
Ato osi sabu engon dura sitatam on siduduran kwakwan. Osi siyau,“On mamaba ato osi bobo obis engon efofour! Mat On ebiyames sabu tainas fotis on dura setatam a awas kokis on dura sebikakafun!”
